verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.

verses.he: נוֹדָ֣ע בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.en: In Judah is God known; His name is great in Israel.
In Salem also is set His tabernacle, And His dwelling-place in Zion.

verses.he: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: There He broke the fiery shafts of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
Glorious art Thou and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.

verses.he: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־מָצְא֖וּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: The stout-hearted are bereft of sense, they sleep their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.he: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃
verses.en: At Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, They are cast into a dead sleep, the riders also and the horses.

verses.he: אַתָּ֤ה׀ נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: Thou, even Thou, art terrible; And who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?

verses.he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃
verses.en: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
When God arose to judgment, To save all the humble of the earth. Selah

verses.he: כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃
verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee; The residue of wrath shalt Thou gird upon Thee.

verses.he: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהוָ֪ה אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כָּל־סְבִיבָ֑יו יוֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God; Let all that are round about Him bring presents unto Him that is to be feared;
He minisheth the spirit of princes; He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
